name: @wealthai/chat-native
description: The ONE React Native chat surface (docs/49 ASTRAL-105, amended by the owner ruling of 2026-08-24). The message lifecycle, the transcript, the bubble and the composer live here rather than inside one app, so `apps/mobile` and `apps/astro` are the SAME chat differing only in (a) brand tokens and copy, (b) the widget/block set they register, and (c) whether the platform router runs at all. Everything app-local the surface needs — a token, an upload, a transcription, an analytics counter, the routing decision — is INJECTED through `installChatHost`, never imported from `@/lib/*` (F22's lesson, ASTRAL-99's pattern).
